report.clinical_summary: The patient was diagnosed with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) two years ago and is currently in partial remission on Ibrutinib. They report significant fatigue, frequent infections, swollen lymph nodes, and bruising, alongside side effects like diarrhea and joint aches. Their daily life has been disrupted, with work becoming harder and hobbies and social time cut back. They acknowledge the chronic nature of the illness but remain hopeful for a cure. They view the medication as necessary for management but have concerns about long-term side effects. They actively manage their health through diet, sleep, and exercise, and trust their medical team.
